name: Directory Of Toilets In Public Parks
description:
This dataset lists public park toilets across New York City's five boroughs, with 616 sampled records and six fields. Each record identifies a facility by name (such as a playground or park), gives its location as a street or intersection, and notes the borough. It also indicates whether the facility is open year-round and whether it is handicap accessible, though the accessibility field is populated for only about a fifth of records and, where present, always reads "Yes." A comments field captures occasional operational notes, such as temporary closures or reduced hours during the school day, but it is empty for nearly all rows.

The data could support residents, visitors, and planners in locating public restrooms in parks, comparing availability by borough, or identifying which facilities stay open through the winter. It may also be useful for accessibility-focused analysis, mapping, or service-gap studies, though users should account for the sparse accessibility and comments fields and verify current status before relying on any single record.
